# Changelog

## 0.1.0-alpha.2 — 2026-07-23

- Require BBK core `0.1.0-alpha.4`.
- Declare supported `ImplementationStructureContract` and `ExecutionSlice` projection capability.
- Add deterministic `structure`, `slice`, and `structure-review` entrypoints.
- Add Rust-namespaced projection, review, and planned-versus-actual schemas.
- Add Rust implementation-structure, execution-slicing, and focused structure-review skills.
- Add type-driven guidance for identity, state, boundary, ownership, failure, and evidence types.
- Add materiality-aware resolver routing without changing routine alpha.1 behavior.
- Carry generic object and projection digests into effective profile locks.
- Add planned gate recipes for contract validation, projection validation, ownership/public-contract drift, touchpoint evidence, and scaffolding disposition.
- Add positive, negative, legacy, harmless-divergence, and material-divergence alpha.4 fixtures.
- Extend the OMP surface with structure, slice, and structure-review tools and commands.
- Preserve `mutest-rs` as the only operative mutation-testing integration.
- Preserve alpha.1 preflight, resolver, gate-planning, installation, and evidence behavior.

## 0.1.0-alpha.1 — 2026-07-23

- Added the first BBK Rust profile package.
- Imported and indexed 265 Rust rules and seven supplied skill packs.
- Added proportional task/change/role routing.
- Added deterministic preflight, gate planning, and profile locks.
- Added unsafe/FFI, package/release, and evidence modules.
- Standardized mutation-testing integration on `mutest-rs`.
- Added Codex, OMP, Claude Code, and generic installation surfaces.

## 0.1.0-alpha.3 — 2026-07-24

Added typed State–Decision–Effect and Review Assurance dispatch, mappings, schemas, fixtures, OMP surfaces, migration guidance, and release qualification while preserving alpha.2 skill bytes and legacy interfaces.
